title: Prepare the optional table reader before processing documents
summary: When enabled, the optional table reader loads before accepting documents so model startup does not consume the first request’s time limit.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

The optional financial table reader prepares its offline models before the service accepts requests or resumes queued OCR work. Missing models stop startup instead of failing the first document.

## Why it matters

Document requests no longer have to wait for this model initialization within their own time limit. This does not remove queue limits or guarantee table recognition.

## Where to find it

Applies when the optional table reader is enabled. General availability remains under financial accuracy and capacity qualification.
